home.kicker: A middle-grade collection for readers aged 9 to 13
home.title: Four young narrators. Four corners of the world.
home.lead: Notebook novels about the places we come from and the choices that make us who we are. Each book can be read on its own.

how.p: The whole novel, free in your browser, with illustrations, a reading mode for any light, and no accounts or ads.
Print and EPUB editions in English, French and Spanish, each with or without the Discovery Guide.
A guide with background, discussion questions and activities for every chapter group.

parents.title: For parents and teachers
parents.lead: What to expect from the book, how to read it with young readers, and how this site treats your privacy.
parents.privacy: This website does not use cookies, advertising or analytics. Your reading position and display choices are stored only in your own browser and are never sent to us. Children are never asked for personal information; the forms on this site are for parents, teachers and librarians.
parents.safety: The book shows dangerous situations on purpose, and also shows adults handling them. Please read the safety section of the Discovery Guide before any kite-flying activity, and never copy what the characters do on the roof.

about.title: About the collection
about.p1: My Corner of the World follows four fictional young narrators in four countries on three continents. Each book can be read on its own, and they speak to each other in surprising ways.
about.p2: Every volume is written as a notebook: dates, lists, things said and things held back. The stories are invented; the places, trades, festivals and dangers they describe are real, and each book ends with a note that separates the two.
about.p3: The books are written for readers aged 9 to 13 and can be shared with younger children and with older readers.
